description: An elementary embedding has a model of a given first-order theory as its source if and only if its target is a model of that theory.
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.ElementaryEmbedding.theory_model_iff.{u_1, u_2, u_5, u_6} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type u_1}
  {N : Type u_2} [L.Structure M] [L.Structure N] (f : L.ElementaryEmbedding M N) (T : L.Theory) : M ⊨ T ↔ N ⊨ T
